caseName: Pluto Oil & Gas Co. v. Miller
caseNameFull: Pluto Oil & Gas Company v. H. C. Miller
attorneys: Mr. L. 0. Lyle, Mr. W. V. Pryor, and Mr. D. A. McDougal, for defendant in error, in support of the motion. Mr. Henry B. Martin and Mr. B. B. Blakeney appeared for plaintiffs in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6. Petition for certiorari denied.
